title: Continuous multi-source reconciliation engine
objective: Match every external bank, custodian and payment-rail observation to internal ledger entries, and fund-level totals to GL control accounts, with exact matches auto-passed and all others queued.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor Controller with Unbound reconciliation component owner)

title: Stale-feed fail-closed release gate
objective: Prevent payment release or new reservations from relying on a bank or custodian balance older than the approved freshness window.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor Controller with Unbound reconciliation component owner)

title: Versioned tolerance policy with dual approval to loosen
objective: Store every match rule and tolerance as an effective-dated policy version; any loosening requires a second, independent approver; an AI principal cannot approve.

title: No-plug invariant
objective: Reject any journal that clears a reconciliation difference without a typed reason, linked evidence and authorized approver.

title: Break case lifecycle with aging escalation
objective: Open, own, age and escalate every break; materiality and aging thresholds drive automatic escalation and scoped blocking.

title: Scoped publication block on material break
objective: Block statements, NAV publication and new reservations for funds affected by a material open break, without halting unaffected funds.

title: Duty conflict evaluation per material action
objective: Evaluate request, approval and reconciliation roles for the same transaction and deny self-attestation, including for AI agent principals.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound governance and sponsor Controller)

title: Generated close certification package
objective: Produce per-period evidence that invariants pass, material breaks are resolved and the attested sample is complete, as the sole basis for close certification.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound CFO for SOC 1 readiness; sponsor Controller for sign-off)

title: Independent attestation of auto-passed sample
objective: A principal independent of the reconciliation configuration attests a risk-stratified sample of auto-passed matches each period.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound CFO for SOC 1 readiness; sponsor Controller for sign-off)

title: SOC 1 Type 2 examination covering reconciliation
objective: Obtain an independent service auditor's SOC 1 Type 2 report covering reconciliation, ledger posting, NAV, change management and logical access.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: Unbound CFO for SOC 1 readiness; sponsor Controller for sign-off)
residual_risks: No report exists; reliance unavailable until at least one full observation period completes.

title: Raw feed preservation and append-only evidence store
objective: Persist every external file or message exactly as received with hash, and append normalized and decision records without update or delete.

title: Deterministic replay check
objective: Periodically rebuild reconciliation projections from append-only evidence and compare checksums with issued results.

title: Unknown-outcome resolution protocol per rail
objective: Hold any payment with unknown outcome in an explicit state until evidence resolves it; forbid re-initiation except under the original idempotency key after proven NotSubmitted.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor Treasury with Controller review)

title: Migration reconciliation gate
objective: Block cutover until staged balances, units and open items reconcile to the predecessor platform and parallel validation passes.
owner: Unassigned (proposed: sponsor Treasury with Controller review)
